We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Sales Lead Poland (m/f/d) Your role:

You own the Poland market on the sales side. You'll build and lead a high-performing AE & SDR team from the ground up - hiring, ramping, coaching and holding the bar on day-to-day execution.

You stay close to the front line: running deals yourself when it matters, jumping into demos and discovery calls, and setting the standard for how we sell in Poland.

You own the Polish sales number - monthly and yearly targets - and you're accountable for a reliable forecast. You work hand in hand with Marketing on lead-gen for the PL market and with Customer Success on clean handoffs.

You translate what works in DACH into the polish context, feed learnings back to the leadership team, and shape how the whole polish sales motion scales.

What's waiting for you:

 * Market ownership: Full responsibility for fonio's sales performance in Poland.

 * Team building: Hire, ramp and coach the polish AE & SDR team as we scale.

 * Player-coach: Lead from the front - stay in deals and demos, not just dashboards.

 * Quota ownership: Clear monthly and yearly targets for the PL market - you?re setting it up for the team.

 * Cross-functional impact: Close collaboration with Marketing, Customer Success and the founders.

 * Build, don't maintain: Shape the Polish sales motion in a fast-scaling startup.

What we offer:

 * €70,000 - 100,000 (base + uncapped commission; depending on experience)

 * On-site in Warsaw (with a 2-month onboarding on-site in Vienna to start)

 * Top equipment of your choice and extremely short decision paths

 * Direct line to the founders and real ownership over an entire market

What you bring:

 * Several years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of closing along a clear funnel

 * First leadership or team-lead experience

 * Strong product and technology understanding

 * Polish at native level and confident, fluent English; German is a strong plus

 * Startup mindset - builder mentality

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro call

 * 60 min Skill Interview with our CCO Alex Brix

 * 20 min Language & Team Fit

 * 20 min Culture Interview

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. 

The impact you'll make

At Lam, as a Material Program Manager (MPM), you play a pivotal role in driving supply chain success across development and product programs. You coordinate material and sourcing activities in cross-functional teams to ensure cost-effective, scalable, and risk-resilient supply solutions from early development through manufacturing readiness.Acting as a key interface between Engineering, Program Management, and suppliers, you help shape sourcing strategies that support innovation, speed, and ramp readiness as well as long-term operational excellence in Lam's global supply chain. 1 Materials Program Manager / Technischer Einkauf (all genders) Job-ID: 197415 I Work Location Model: On-site Flex I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

 * Perform cost analysis, volume planning, and supply-risk assessments for assigned programs and suppliers. 

 * Drive cost engineering, cost reduction, and manufacturing ramp readiness from supplier onboarding to serial release.

 * Partner closely with suppliers and Quality teams to resolve technical, quality, and manufacturability issues impacting cost, schedule, or scale-up readiness.

 * Support commodity and technology-focused sourcing strategies, including market intelligence, supplier technology assessments, pricing trends, and long-term material availability.

 * Define, document, and present program sourcing strategies to stakeholders and management, translating technical and commercial inputs into structured program updates (e.g. PowerPoint, program reviews).

Who we're looking for

 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, Business Engineering, or a related field, combined with minimujm 4 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, or technical procurement.

 * Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Excel,)

 * Communication skills, both written and verbal, in English and German.

 * Exceptional interpersonal and influence skills.

Preferred qualifications

 * Experience in the semiconductor industry or other high-tech industries.

 * Prior experience in supply chain, technical procurement or similar functions.

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
